sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Lethargy for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies Beguilement for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 40.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Whirlwind] Himari Azuma or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
